independent_review.method: Independent heap cache and closed-form fixture selection; imports no simulator code; reconstructs cache counters, physical traffic, per-query coverage, channel/die/fast resource bounds; schedule checked by full-fallback identity and native summary-only delta, not independent event reconstruction

negative_controls.tests: Explicit omitted-byte/page/block/score mutations, required-page loss, unfair selection, physical-cap violation, false fallback, candidate/query mismatch, invalid/nonfinite inputs and cache-capacity failure; unchecked attribution controls

reproduction.note: Runs partially overlapped; these are simulator host costs, not hardware or model performance

scope: Synthetic fixtures and assumed storage placement only; no trained attention, reasoning-quality evaluation, model download, hardware operation, remote compute or CI run
